SELECT 'Sales' AS record_type, DATE(order_ts) AS date, store_name, region, category, product_name,
       CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS qty, sales_after_discount_before_tax AS amount
FROM capretailnew.gold.gold_fact_sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Refund' AS record_type, DATE(return_ts) AS date, store_name, store_region AS region, category, product_name,
       return_quantity AS qty, refund_amount AS amount
FROM capretailnew.gold.gold_fact_returns
